settings.BUYGPTPULS_API_BASE.help: Temporary email API root address, default https://email.buygptpuls.com
settings.BUYGPTPULS_API_BASE.label: buygptpuls API address
settings.BUYGPTPULS_API_KEY.help: X-API-Key used when creating a temporary email; this Key is not required for the public receiving interface
settings.BUYGPTPULS_API_KEY.label: buygptpuls API Key
settings.BUYGPTPULS_DOMAIN.help: The domain submitted when creating the email; leave it blank and the server will randomly select the domain name to enable. If you fill it in, the domain name will be used permanently, such as buygptpuls.com.
settings.BUYGPTPULS_DOMAIN.label: buygptpuls domain name
settings.BUYGPTPULS_DOMAIN_LEVEL.help: domain_level submitted when creating the email; 2=buygptpuls.com, 3=random.buygptpuls.com, default 5
settings.BUYGPTPULS_DOMAIN_LEVEL.label: buygptpuls domain name level
settings.BUYGPTPULS_PREFIX.help: The prefix submitted when creating the email; it can be left blank. If left blank, the email name will be completely composed of random characters.
settings.BUYGPTPULS_PREFIX.label: buygptpuls prefix
settings.BUYGPTPULS_RANDOM_LENGTH.help: The random_length submitted when creating the email; when the prefix is ​​empty, it is approximately equal to the length of the email name prefix, and when there is a prefix, it indicates the length of random characters appended afterwards.
settings.BUYGPTPULS_RANDOM_LENGTH.label: buygptpuls email length
settings.CHATGPT_BOOTSTRAP_MODE.help: Fixed mode skips the ChatGPT homepage; live homepage mode keeps the current Cloudflare solver flow.
settings.CHATGPT_BOOTSTRAP_MODE.label: ChatGPT homepage bootstrap
settings.CHATGPT_FIXED_BUILD_ID.help: The oai-client-version sent in fixed mode; it must start with prod-.
settings.CHATGPT_FIXED_BUILD_ID.label: Fixed ChatGPT Build ID
settings.CHATGPT_FIXED_BUILD_NUMBER.help: The numeric oai-client-build-number sent by desktop fixed mode.
settings.CHATGPT_FIXED_PAGE_VARIANT.help: Desktop requires a numeric Build Number; mobile requires an empty Build Number.
settings.CHATGPT_FIXED_SCRIPT_SOURCES.he: One https://chatgpt.com script URL per line; empty by default for this experiment.
settings.CODEX_OAUTH_SKIP_PHONE.help: Only email accounts are valid: Codex OAuth When it is necessary to bind a phone, it will immediately return failure and will not continue to receive the code to bind the mobile phone.
settings.CODEX_OAUTH_SKIP_PHONE.label: Codex OAuth Skip mobile
settings.CODEX_PROXY_POOL.help: Advanced mode is in effect: Codex is automatically extracted and manually rerun on the account asset page, priority is given to random selection from here; when it is empty, priority is given to falling back to the global proxy pool.
settings.CODEX_PROXY_POOL.label: Provide Codex proxy pool (advanced)
settings.CODEX_SMS_SOURCE.help: Codex OAuth Use the platform access code or API access code number pool when verifying via mobile phone.
settings.CODEX_SMS_SOURCE.label: Provide Codex code reception method
settings.CPA_API_URL.help: CPA service address, you can fill in the root address or /v0/management/auth-files, the backend will automatically normalize
settings.CPA_API_URL.label: CPA interface address
settings.CPA_ENABLED.help: After opening, the Codex refresh_token will be automatically uploaded to CPA; the Codex page can also be manually uploaded to the selected account
settings.CPA_ENABLED.label: CPA upload
settings.CPA_LOGIN_PASSWORD.help: CPA management interface Bearer Token / login password; after saving, the front end only displays the mask
settings.CPA_LOGIN_PASSWORD.label: CPA login password
settings.AUTH_CALLBACK_SENTINEL_REPLAY_E: Reuse the original pre-create Sentinel request body; disable to restore the no-replay behavior.
settings.EMAIL_SOURCE.help: After selection, the page will automatically display only the configuration from the corresponding source: Outlook account pool, buygptpuls temporary email or API SMS verification email
settings.EMAIL_SOURCE.label: Email source
settings.EMAIL_FAILURE_MAX_RETRIES.help: How many additional attempts the same Outlook or API mailbox may receive after its first registration failure. The default 2 blacklists it after 3 consecutive failures.
settings.EMAIL_FAILURE_MAX_RETRIES.label: Mailbox failure retries
settings.ENABLE_2FA.help: After registration is completed, a dynamic password will be automatically set (an additional OTP email will be received)
settings.ENABLE_2FA.label: Enable 2FA(TOTP)
settings.ENABLE_CODEX_AUTO.help: After successful registration, Codex authorization will automatically run (new session)
settings.ENABLE_CODEX_AUTO.label: Enable Codex OAuth
settings.ENABLE_FLOW_TRIGGER.help: After successful registration, the internal Flow interface is automatically called (does not affect the registration result)
settings.ENABLE_FLOW_TRIGGER.label: Enable Flow triggering
settings.ENABLE_PAYMENT_LINK_AUTO_EXTRAC: Queue payment-link extraction through the selected provider after the account is saved.
settings.PAYMENT_LINK_PROVIDER.help: Affects new tasks only; historical tasks keep their saved provider.
settings.PAYMENT_LINK_PROVIDER.label: Payment-link provider
settings.ENABLE_POST_REGISTER_PASSWORD.h: After successful registration, set a new password and you will need to receive another email.
settings.OTP_MAX_WAIT.help: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the verification code email. Failure will occur if timeout occurs.
settings.OTP_MAX_WAIT.label: OTP Longest wait (seconds)
settings.OTP_POLL_INTERVAL.help: How many seconds to check for new emails
settings.OTP_POLL_INTERVAL.label: OTP Polling interval (seconds)
settings.OUTLOOK_CONNECTION_CACHE_TTL.he: Local IMAP connection reuse time, reducing the cost of continuous polling login
settings.OUTLOOK_FETCH_LIMIT.help: How many recent emails are read from the inbox each round for OTP matching
settings.OUTLOOK_FETCH_LIMIT.label: Outlook single round read count
settings.OUTLOOK_FETCH_MODE.help: auto=Outlook REST→Graph→IMAP; rest=Only Outlook REST; graph=Only Microsoft Graph; imap=Only IMAP XOAUTH2.
settings.OUTLOOK_FETCH_MODE.label: Outlook Receipt Protocol
settings.OUTLOOK_USE_PASSWORD_LOGIN.help: Closed by default; use XOAUTH2 of client_id+refresh_token when closing
settings.PHONE_REGISTRATION_SMS_SOURCE.h: When registering a phone, use the SMS verification platform or the API SMS verification number pool. It is only displayed when the registration mode is phone registration.
settings.PROXY_MODE.help: Global mode: registration/withdrawal of Codex will be randomly selected from the global proxy pool; advanced mode: registration and withdrawal of Codex can use their own dedicated proxy pools.
settings.PROXY_MODE.label: proxy mode
settings.PROXY_MODE.options.global: Default mode: Use global proxy pool
settings.PROXY_POOL.help: Default/secure proxy pool. One agent per line; leaving a blank line will be ignored; if it is empty, the account will fall back to the original agent or direct connection according to the scenario.
settings.PROXY_POOL.label: Global proxy pool (one per line)
settings.REGISTER_BATCH_COUNT.help: The target number of successful accounts after clicking "Start Registration" on the registration task page; the system only submits attempts based on the number of concurrencies, and will automatically fill in the gaps if they fail, ranging from 1 to 10000
settings.REGISTER_BATCH_COUNT.label: Target successes
settings.REGISTER_BIRTHDAY.label: Default birthday
settings.REGISTER_PROXY_POOL.help: Advanced mode takes effect: the registration priority is randomly selected from here; when it is empty, it falls back to the global proxy pool.
settings.REGISTER_PROXY_POOL.label: Register Agent Pool (Advanced)
settings.REGISTER_WORKERS.help: The maximum number of concurrent attempts used when starting a batch on the registration task page, ranging from 1 to 50; it takes effect immediately when there are no active tasks.
settings.REGISTER_WORKERS.label: Concurrent threads
legacy.registration-limits.workers-range: Concurrent threads must be between 1 and 50
settings.REGISTRATION_MODE.help: email = email address OTP registration; phone = phone registration on the SMS verification platform.
settings.REGISTRATION_MODE.label: Registration mode
settings.RISK_PROFILE_ID.help: Native Chrome 146 is aligned to four successful captures; WeChat XWEB and the older Chrome146 profile are rollback options.
settings.RISK_PROFILE_ID.label: Registration risk profile
settings.SMS_API_KEY.label: API key
settings.SMS_BLACKLIST_ON_BAD_CODE.help: After the target station explicitly rejects the number or verification code, it will be added to the local blacklist and try to cancel the platform.
settings.SMS_BLACKLIST_ON_BAD_CODE.label: The failed number is added to the blacklist
settings.SMS_CANCEL_ON_TIMEOUT.help: Automatically call the platform to cancel/release the number after waiting for the SMS to time out.
settings.SMS_CANCEL_ON_TIMEOUT.label: Automatically cancel number after timeout
settings.SMS_CODE_WAIT.help: The maximum number of seconds for a single number to wait for the arrival of a text message. If it times out, the number will be changed.
settings.SMS_CODE_WAIT.label: Single number and other SMS (seconds)
settings.SMS_COUNTRY.help: GrizzlySMS country numeric code, commonly used: United States=187/Portugal=117/Chile=151. Can be viewed on the platform number selection page
settings.SMS_COUNTRY.label: country code
settings.SMS_MAX_RETRIES.help: When a number cannot receive text messages/is rejected by OpenAI, change to the next number and try again for a maximum number of times.
settings.SMS_MAX_RETRIES.label: Number change retries
settings.SMS_POLL_INTERVAL.help: Check the SMS status of the SMS verification platform every few seconds
settings.SMS_POLL_INTERVAL.label: SMS polling interval (seconds)
settings.SMS_SERVICE.help: GrizzlySMS service code: OpenAI=dr. Generally no need to change
settings.SMS_SERVICE.label: service code
settings.SUB2API_API_KEY.help: The background API Key used by the request header x-api-key; after saving, the front end only displays the mask
settings.SUB2API_API_KEY.label: SUB2API APIKEY
settings.SUB2API_API_URL.help: Sub2API service root address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080
settings.SUB2API_API_URL.label: SUB2API interface address
settings.SUB2API_ENABLED.help: After opening, the Codex refresh_token will be automatically uploaded to Sub2API; the Codex page can also be manually uploaded to the selected account
settings.SUB2API_ENABLED.label: SUB2API upload
settings.SUB2API_GROUP_IDS.help: Automatically write after selecting from the "Get Online Group" button; multiple groups are separated by commas
settings.SUB2API_GROUP_IDS.label: Upload group
settings.TELEGRAM_AUTH_ALLOWED_USERS.hel: Leave blank = the current Telegram account will be automatically locked upon successful login for the first time; it will be used as a whitelist when filling in multiple user IDs or @username.
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_BASE_URL.help: The OAuth service root address accessed by the backend of this website; the browser will not expose this address.
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_BASE_URL.label: Telegram OAuth service address
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.label: Telegram Client ID
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.he: OAuth site application client_secret, only saves the running configuration in the backend and will not be returned to the browser.
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI.hel: You can leave it blank to automatically use the current access address /auth/telegram/callback; please fill in the fixed address when OAuth backend requires exact matching.
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_SCOPE.help: Default is "profile.basic message.send", log in and allow the backend to send Telegram notifications to authorized users.
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_SCOPE.label: Telegram authorization scope
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_TIMEOUT.help: Timeout for backend request OAuth service.
settings.TELEGRAM_OAUTH_TIMEOUT.label: Telegram request timeout (seconds)
settings.USE_EMAIL_SERVICE.help: True=Automatically retrieve email from Outlook pool and automatically receive OTP; False=Manual input
settings.USE_EMAIL_SERVICE.label: Automatically retrieve email address + receive code
settings.UPI_CARD.help: Shared card code for UPI and Kakao extraction tasks. It is stored only on the server.
settings.UPI_CARD.label: Payment-link card code
settings.UPI_DEFAULT_CLAIM_COUNT.help: Maximum number of QR codes a scanner receives for each claim.
settings.UPI_DEFAULT_CLAIM_COUNT.label: Default QR claim count
settings.UPI_MAX_PENDING_SCAN_TASKS.help: Maximum combined count of extracting and extracted but unpaid tasks.
